title: Build monthly usage invoices
summary: A billing service turns customer usage events in a date window into monthly invoices using fictional rates supplied by the exercise. Group billable usage by customer and return the required invoice totals and detail rows. Produce invoices from billable events across customers and a date window. All rates are fictional.
requirements: Use only events with a YYYY-MM-DD date within the inclusive start/end range; ignore disputed events.
Reject a negative or noninteger units value with an Error.
Aggregate units per customer before pricing. The first 100 units per customer are free, the next 900 cost 4¢ each, and remaining units cost 2¢ each.
Return every customer with at least one included event, even if its invoice is 0¢. Sort by customerId.
Return { customerId, units, amountCents } for each invoice.
hints: Filter by the date strings first. ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings can be compared lexically.
Aggregate usage in a Map keyed by customerId.
For total units u, charge Math.min(Math.max(u - 100, 0), 900) × 4 plus Math.max(u - 1000, 0) × 2 cents.

tests.name: Applies the free allowance across events
Keeps allowances separate and sorts customers
